mapper.sql: m.id, m.product_id, m.order_id, m.sender_id, sender.username as sender_name, m.receiver_id, receiver.username as receiver_name, m.content, m.read_time, m.create_time
mapper.select: select from tb_second_hand_message m left join tb_user sender on m.sender_id = sender.id left join tb_user receiver on m.receiver_id = receiver.id where m.deleted = 0 and m.product_id = #{productId} and (m.sender_id = #{userId} or m.receiver_id = #{userId}) order by m.create_time asc, m.id asc limit 20

select from tb_second_hand_message m left join tb_user sender on m.sender_id = sender.id left join tb_user receiver on m.receiver_id = receiver.id where m.id = #{id} and m.deleted = 0 and (m.sender_id = #{userId} or m.receiver_id = #{userId})
select m.id, m.product_id, m.sender_id, m.receiver_id, m.create_time from tb_second_hand_message m where m.id = #{id} and (m.sender_id = #{userId} or m.receiver_id = #{userId})

select from tb_second_hand_message m left join tb_user sender on m.sender_id = sender.id left join tb_user receiver on m.receiver_id = receiver.id where m.deleted = 0 and m.product_id = #{productId} and (m.sender_id = #{userId} or m.receiver_id = #{userId})
and ((m.sender_id = #{userId} and m.receiver_id = #{counterpartyId}) or (m.sender_id = #{counterpartyId} and m.receiver_id = #{userId}))
and (m.create_time < #{cursor.createTime} or m.create_time is null or (m.create_time = #{cursor.createTime} and m.id < #{cursor.id}))
and m.create_time is null and m.id < #{cursor.id}
and (m.create_time > #{cursor.createTime} or (m.create_time = #{cursor.createTime} and m.id > #{cursor.id}))
and (m.create_time is not null or (m.create_time is null and m.id > #{cursor.id}))
order by m.create_time asc, m.id asc order by m.create_time desc, m.id desc
limit #{query.limit}

select latest.product_id, p.title as product_title, p.id as media_product_id, #{userId} as access_user_id, latest.counterparty_id, counterparty.username as counterparty_name, coalesce(latest.order_id, ( select history.order_id from tb_second_hand_message history where history.deleted = 0 and history.product_id = latest.product_id and history.order_id is not null and ((history.sender_id = #{userId} and history.receiver_id = latest.counterparty_id) or (history.receiver_id = #{userId} and history.sender_id = latest.counterparty_id)) order by history.create_time desc, history.id desc limit 1)) as order_id, latest.content as last_message, latest.create_time as last_message_time, (select count(*) from tb_second_hand_message unread where unread.deleted = 0 and unread.product_id = latest.product_id and unread.sender_id = latest.counterparty_id and unread.receiver_id = #{userId} and unread.read_time is null) as unread_count from ( select m.id, m.product_id, m.order_id, m.content, m.create_time, case when m.sender_id = #{userId} then m.receiver_id else m.sender_id end as counterparty_id from tb_second_hand_message m where m.deleted = 0 and (m.sender_id = #{userId} or m.receiver_id = #{userId}) and not exists ( select 1 from tb_second_hand_message newer where newer.deleted = 0 and newer.product_id = m.product_id and (newer.sender_id = #{userId} or newer.receiver_id = #{userId}) and ((newer.sender_id = m.sender_id and newer.receiver_id = m.receiver_id) or (newer.sender_id = m.receiver_id and newer.receiver_id = m.sender_id)) and (newer.create_time > m.create_time or (m.create_time is null and newer.create_time is not null) or ((newer.create_time <=> m.create_time) and newer.id > m.id))) order by m.create_time desc, m.id desc limit #{query.limit} offset #{query.offset} ) latest left join tb_second_hand_product p on p.id = latest.product_id and p.deleted = 0 left join tb_user counterparty on counterparty.id = latest.counterparty_id order by latest.create_time desc, latest.id desc

select from tb_second_hand_message m left join tb_user sender on m.sender_id = sender.id left join tb_user receiver on m.receiver_id = receiver.id where m.deleted = 0 and (m.sender_id = #{userId} or m.receiver_id = #{userId}) order by m.create_time desc, m.id desc limit 20

select from tb_second_hand_message m left join tb_user sender on m.sender_id = sender.id left join tb_user receiver on m.receiver_id = receiver.id where m.deleted = 0 and m.product_id = #{productId} and ( (m.sender_id = #{userId} and m.receiver_id = #{counterpartyId}) or (m.sender_id = #{counterpartyId} and m.receiver_id = #{userId}) ) order by m.create_time asc, m.id asc limit 20

select from tb_second_hand_message m left join tb_user sender on m.sender_id = sender.id left join tb_user receiver on m.receiver_id = receiver.id
order by m.create_time desc, m.id desc limit #{query.limit} offset #{query.offset}
